import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import dispatch_primary


class DispatchPrimaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_equal_nonidentical_channel_is_processed(self):
        primary = "primary-channel-value"
        channel = "".join(["primary", "-channel", "-value"])
        self.assertEqual(channel, primary)
        self.assertIsNot(channel, primary)
        self.assertEqual(
            dispatch_primary([{"channel": channel, "payload": 4}], {primary: [lambda x: x + 1]}, primary),
            [5],
        )

    def test_order_filtering_and_independent_payload_copies(self):
        payload = {"values": [1]}
        events = [
            {"channel": "other", "payload": {"ignored": True}},
            {"channel": "p", "payload": payload},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(events)
        received = []

        def mutate(value):
            received.append(value)
            value["values"].append(2)
            return len(value["values"])

        def observe(value):
            received.append(value)
            return list(value["values"])

        result = dispatch_primary(events, {"p": [mutate, observe], "other": []}, "p")
        self.assertEqual(result, [2, [1]])
        self.assertEqual(events, original)
        self.assertIsNot(received[0], payload)
        self.assertIsNot(received[1], payload)
        self.assertIsNot(received[0], received[1])
        self.assertIsNot(received[0]["values"], received[1]["values"])

    def test_empty_inputs_and_missing_primary_handlers(self):
        self.assertEqual(dispatch_primary([], {}, "p"), [])
        self.assertEqual(dispatch_primary([{"channel": "p", "payload": 1}], {}, "p"), [])
        self.assertIsNot(dispatch_primary([], {}, "p"), dispatch_primary([], {}, "p"))

    def test_entire_input_is_validated_before_any_handler_runs(self):
        calls = []
        events = [
            {"channel": "p", "payload": 1},
            {"channel": 2, "payload": 2},
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dispatch_primary(events, {"p": [lambda value: calls.append(value)]}, "p")
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])

        valid_events = [{"channel": "p", "payload": 1}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dispatch_primary(valid_events, {"p": [lambda value: calls.append(value)], "unused": [3]}, "p")
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        valid_event = {"channel": "p", "payload": None}
        valid_handlers = {"p": []}
        cases = [
            ((valid_event,), valid_handlers, "p"),
            ([valid_event], [], "p"),
            ([valid_event], valid_handlers, 1),
            ([None], valid_handlers, "p"),
            ([{"channel": "p"}], valid_handlers, "p"),
            ([{"channel": "p", "payload": 1, "extra": 2}], valid_handlers, "p"),
            ([{"channel": 1, "payload": 1}], valid_handlers, "p"),
            ([valid_event], {1: []}, "p"),
            ([valid_event], {"p": ()}, "p"),
            ([valid_event], {"p": [None]}, "p"),
        ]
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                dispatch_primary(*args)

    def test_handler_exceptions_propagate(self):
        class HandlerFailure(Exception):
            pass

        def fail(payload):
            raise HandlerFailure(payload)

        with self.assertRaises(HandlerFailure):
            dispatch_primary([{"channel": "p", "payload": "boom"}], {"p": [fail]}, "p")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
